text:
Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Trailer
Vice City, USA. Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida — forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive.

Check out the new Launch Trailer, featuring new music from electronic duo Justice, composers of the original score from Grand Theft Auto VI. 

The new standalone Justice single, “Flower in a Hurricane” feat. Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard, is also available on Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, the official soundtrack which is currently available to pre-save on all major music streaming services and up for pre-order on vinyl or CD.

Grand Theft Auto VI arrives November 19.

FIRE AND ASHES - Official Launch Trailer
Enter a nightmare as Henry Gray awakens in a psychiatric hospital in 1977. Uncover his past, solve puzzles and survive disturbing encounters where reality and hallucination collide. Optional voice interaction lets your whispers, shouts and breathing affect the experience. text:
Cyberpunk 2077 | Broken Dreams | Edgerunners 2 Update Launch Trailer
Seen the anime? Play the update — if you’re ready…

Dive back into Night City with the free Edgerunners 2 Update for Cyberpunk 2077, featuring content inspired by Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2. 

Take on a new quest that takes place before the anime’s raw, brutal story begins; carry on Jackie’s legacy with the Dual Wielding playstyle; and discover much more as you pick up the pieces in the City of (Broken) Dreams.

The Edgerunners 2 Update is out now on XBOX Series X|S and is available with XBOX Play Anywhere.
